functions.name: uptime
functions.doc:
Seconds since the runtime started.

```luau
assert(uptime() >= 0)
```

constants.name: MAX_ARGS
constants.doc: The most arguments a single call takes.

functions.name: decode
functions.doc:
Parse JSON text. The result is `unknown`: check what it is before using it.

```luau
local value, err = json.decode("{\"n\": 1}")
assert(err == nil)
if type(value) == "table" then
    local object = value :: { [string]: unknown } -- checked above: it is a table
    assert(object.n == 1)
end
```

ok.reason: whatever JSON text was parsed: its shape is the text's, not this API's

functions.name: identity
functions.doc:
`value` itself, not a copy: a table comes back as the same table (`mlua_ir::Live`).

```luau
local t = {}
assert(json.identity(t) == t)
```

ty.reason: whatever the script passed: it comes back as it is, the same table or function
whatever the script passed: it comes back as it is, the same table or function

functions.name: encode
functions.doc: Write plain data as JSON text.

ty.reason: any plain data a script built: tables, strings, numbers, booleans

functions.name: to_hex
functions.doc:
The hex text of raw bytes (any byte, including `\0`).

```luau
assert(blob.to_hex("\0\255a") == "00ff61")
```

functions.name: from_hex
functions.doc:
The raw bytes of hex text.

```luau
local data = assert(blob.from_hex("00ff61"))
assert(data == "\0\255a")
local _, err = blob.from_hex("0")
assert(err ~= nil and err.kind == "odd_length")
```

functions.name: global_type
functions.doc:
A global of the script's own state: the Lua state is a parameter the script does not pass.

```luau
assert(blob.global_type("print") == "function")
```

functions.name: global_type_later
functions.doc:
The same, after yielding once.

```luau
assert(blob.global_type_later("print") == "function")
```

functions.name: list
functions.doc:
The paths under `path` in the demo's fixed tree, sorted.

```luau
assert(#dir.list("src") == 1)
assert(#dir.list("src", { recursive = true }) == 3)
assert(#dir.list("src", { recursive = true, hidden = true, max_depth = 2 }) == 3)
```

functions.name: area
functions.doc:
The area of a figure.

```luau
assert(draw.area({ kind = "rect", w = 2, h = 3 }) == 6)
```

functions.name: var
functions.doc:
The value of a variable in the demo's fixed environment, or `nil` when it is not set. Not being set is
normal absence, not an error.

```luau
assert(env.var("HOME") == "/home/demo")
assert(env.var("NOPE") == nil)
```

functions.name: var_or
functions.doc: `var(name)`, or `fallback` (default `""`) when it is not set.

functions.name: count_to
functions.doc:
Ticks `1..=n`, one per millisecond.

```luau
local seen = 0
for tick in events.count_to(3):items() do
    seen += tick.n
end
assert(seen == 6)
```

functions.name: failing
functions.doc: Ticks that stop with an error after `after` of them.

functions.name: read
functions.doc:
The text of a file in the demo's fixed filesystem.

```luau
local text, err = fs.read("notes.txt")
assert(err == nil and text == "hello")
local missing, why = fs.read("nope.txt")
assert(missing == nil and why ~= nil and why.kind == "not_found")
```

functions.name: remove
functions.doc: Remove a file: `true`, or the error.

functions.name: midpoint
functions.doc:
The point halfway between `a` and `b`. It carries no label.

```luau
local m = geo.midpoint({ x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = 4, y = 2 })
assert(m.x == 2 and m.y == 1 and m.label == nil)
```

functions.name: distance
functions.doc: The distance between two points.

functions.name: parse
functions.doc:
`"key=value"` lines as a map.

```luau
local map = assert(labels.parse({ "app=web", "tier=front" }))
assert(map.app == "web")
```

functions.name: keys
functions.doc: The keys of a map, sorted.

functions.name: summary
functions.doc: The first key (if any) and how many there are.

functions.name: write
functions.doc:
Write one line to the host's log; returns the line as written.

```luau
assert(log.write("warn", "disk nearly full") == "[warn] disk nearly full")
```

functions.name: describe
functions.doc:
How a container is shown.

```luau
assert(names.describe("web-1") == "container web-1")
```

functions.name: number
functions.doc: The number `text` spells. This module's convention is to raise: a failure is a `ParseError`, raised.

functions.name: error_of
functions.doc:
The `ParseError` a call of this module raised, read back from what `pcall` caught; `nil` for anything else.

```luau
local ok, caught = pcall(parse.number, "x")
assert(not ok)
local err = parse.error_of(caught)
assert(err ~= nil and err.kind == "not_a_number")
```

ty.reason: whatever `pcall` caught: any value can be raised

functions.name: sort_by
functions.doc:
`items` in the order `before` says: `before(left, right)` is `true` when `left` goes first. An error
`before` raises passes through.

```luau
local sorted = sort.sort_by({ "pear", "fig", "apple" }, function(left, right)
    return #left < #right
end)
assert(sorted[1] == "fig" and sorted[3] == "apple")
```

functions.name: each
functions.doc: Calls `visit(item, index)` for each item, in order; how many it visited.

functions.name: sleep
functions.doc:
Wait `ms` milliseconds without blocking other scripts; returns how long it waited.

```luau
assert(task.sleep(1) == 1)
```

functions.name: pad
functions.doc:
Pad `text` on the right with spaces to `width` characters.

```luau
assert(text.pad("id", 6) == "id    ")
```

functions.name: loop
functions.doc:
`text` repeated `times` times. A Rust keyword as a name is a raw identifier: `r#loop` is `loop` to a
script.

functions.name: describe
functions.doc:
How a timeout reads to a person.

```luau
assert(time.describe(1.5) == "1.5s")
assert(time.describe(time.Duration.seconds(2)) == "2s")
```

functions.name: connect
functions.doc:
Connect to a daemon. Sends nothing: the first call does.

```luau
local docker = assert(bollard.connect())
for _, c in assert(docker:list_containers({ all = true })) do
    assert(c.Names ~= nil)
end
```

functions.name: sample
functions.doc:
Two containers as Docker reports them: bollard's own `ContainerSummary`, typed field by field.

```luau
local containers = docker_models.sample()
assert(containers[1].State == "running")
```

functions.name: line
functions.doc: One line for a container: its first name and its state. Takes bollard's type as an argument too.

methods.name: wait
methods.doc:
Wait `ms` milliseconds, then tick; the number of ticks so far.

```luau
local clock = task.Clock.new()
clock:wait(1)
assert(clock:wait(1) == 2)
```

methods.name: plus
methods.doc:
This and `other` together.

```luau
local d = time.Duration.seconds(1):plus(time.Duration.seconds(0.5))
assert(d.as_seconds == 1.5)
```

methods.name: create_container
methods.doc:
Create a container from Docker's own create body (`Image`, `Labels`, `Env`, `HostConfig`, ...): its id.

```luau
local docker = assert(bollard.connect())
local id = assert(docker:create_container("api", { Image = "nginx:1.27", Labels = { app = "api" } }))
assert(docker:find_container("api") ~= nil and #id > 0)
```
